title: What Ingredients Help With Dark Spots? A Plain Guide to the Main Options
ex: Niacinamide, alpha arbutin, kojic acid, azelaic acid, licorice and vitamin C explained: how each helps dark spots look less noticeable and who it suits.
rt: What Ingredients Help With Dark Spots? | Mirc Glow
rd: What ingredients help with dark spots? Niacinamide, alpha arbutin, kojic acid, azelaic acid, licorice and vitamin C compared, with tips on choosing.
keyword: what ingredients help with dark spots
quick: The best-known ingredients for dark spots are niacinamide, alpha arbutin, kojic acid, azelaic acid, licorice extract and vitamin C. They slow extra pigment in different ways, so spots look less noticeable over 8 to 12 weeks. Start with one, patch test, and wear sunscreen daily.
facts: Kojic acid is typically used at about 1–2% in creams.
Niacinamide slows how much pigment moves up into visible skin cells.
Higher strengths of azelaic acid are usually prescribed by dermatologists.
No spot-focused ingredient changes natural skin colour.
